name: The Solution
summary: Only an antidote restores memories the serum took. It wants three things: ash, brain extract and ichor.

stages.journal: A patient's note says there must be an antidote. The diagrams upstairs name three ingredients.
objectives: Brew a dose at a workbench
stages.hint: Gather Mnemonic Residue (the furnace), Noetic Extract (the jars), Unrefined Ichor (the lab or the grotto).

stages.journal: We brewed at least one dose of the antidote.
We left with no antidote, and the worm gone with its ichor.
